definition.definition: Byte-matched (tex:1454-1463): Ruan operator-space matrix-norm axioms — ax_R1 ||AXB||_n <= ||A|| ||X||_k ||B|| (rectangular scalar multiplication and corner compression), ax_R2 direct-sum norm ||diag(X,Y)||_{k+n} = max(||X||_k,||Y||_n); the norm on L is the n=1 norm; self-adjoint operator space = conjugate-linear involution preserving every ||.||_n.
